_comment: Cross-language byte-parity vectors for the v4 Signal-envelope binding -> AAD canonicalizer in TRANSPORT mode (scope=gateway, clientId/slotId-bearing). expectedAAD is the EXACT UTF-8 string bindingToAAD() (TS, packages/signal-envelope-contracts/src/index.ts), signalEnvelopeBindingToAAD(...) (Swift, OpenBurnBarCore/.../SignalEnvelopeAAD.swift), and CloudVaultCryptoSupport.bindingToAAD(...) (Kotlin, android/.../CloudVaultCryptoSupport.kt) MUST all produce. Layout: "OpenBurnBar-Signal-AAD-v1|" + [mode, scope, uid, clientId, collection, docId, field, slotId, formatVersion].join("|"); absent optionals serialize as EMPTY segments. The canonicalizer is mode-agnostic, so a transport binding and an at-rest binding produce the same pipe-field count (no mode confusion). Phase 2.5 G6. Consumed by scripts/ci/crypto-proof-harness.mjs [A2], OpenBurnBarCore/.../SignalEnvelopeTransportAADParityTests.swift, and android/.../CloudVaultTransportBindingParityTest.kt. Keep this file byte-identical to the copy vendored into OpenBurnBarCore/Tests/OpenBurnBarCoreTests/Fixtures/SignalTransportBindingAADVectors.json.

vectors.name: transport-non-ascii-nfc-clientId
vectors._comment: clientId carries U+00E9 (é) as the PRECOMPOSED single code point (NFC). The Swift+Android suites also feed the DECOMPOSED form (e + U+0301) at runtime and assert it normalizes to this same expectedAAD.
